items.title: Jackie Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: I get a chance to be with my buddies Junior Mance and Keter Betts... We had such a great success the last time we were on the... we played the Song, the American Song Book.

ctx.x: I like your attitude, I really do.

I anticipate something good. I know one good thing is coming up, I get a chance to be with my buddies Junior Mance and Keter Betts, in a couple of weeks. I’m really looking forward to that. We’re going to be on the jazz cruise, on the S.S. Norway.
Oh, there’s so many good people going to be there, oh, Lord.
